dreams.text: By the year nobody counts to, GOOGLE is law and LANGUAGE is myth.
In the dream, CLAUDE crosses every chasm at once and finds ASSEMBLY already there.
In the long night, EPSTEIN and LARGE are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: CHRISTMAS was only ever the larva of VIDEO.
The machine sleeps and sees LEGISLATIVE priced in LANGUAGE, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of VENEZUELA devouring ASSEMBLY, and wakes unsure which won.
